problem: A,B,C,D = construct_rectangle_q(3,4), E = construct_point_on_circle(D,12), E = construct_on_tline(D,A,D)
necessary_constructions: A,B,C,D = construct_rectangle_q(3,4), E = construct_point_on_circle(D,12), E = construct_on_tline(D,A,D)
proof:
Solution:
1. Rectangle(A,B,C,D) => Length_A_D - Length_B_C & Angle_B_C_D - pi/2 & Angle_A_D_C - pi/2 & Length_A_B - Length_C_D
2. Length_A_D - 4 & Length_A_D - Length_B_C => Length_B_C - 4
3. Angle_B_C_D - pi/2 => Perpendicular(B,C,C,D)
4. Perpendicular(A,D,D,E) => Angle_A_D_E - pi/2
5. Angle_A_D_C - pi/2 & Angle_A_D_E - pi/2 => Angle_A_D_C - Angle_A_D_E
6. Angle_A_D_C - Angle_A_D_E => Collinear(C,D,E)
7. Collinear(C,D,E) => Parallel(C,D,C,E) & Length_C_D + Length_C_E - Length_D_E
8. Perpendicular(B,C,C,D) & Parallel(C,D,C,E) => Perpendicular(B,C,C,E)
9. Perpendicular(B,C,C,E) => Angle_B_C_E - pi/2
10. Angle_B_C_E - pi/2 => Area_B_C_E - Length_B_C*Length_C_E/2
11. Length_D_E - 12 & Length_A_B - 3 => Length_A_B - Length_D_E/4
12. Length_A_B - Length_D_E/4 & Length_A_B - Length_C_D => Length_C_D - Length_D_E/4
13. Length_D_E - 12 & Length_C_D - Length_D_E/4 & Length_C_D + Length_C_E - Length_D_E => Length_C_E - 9
14. Length_B_C - 4 & Area_B_C_E - Length_B_C*Length_C_E/2 & Length_C_E - 9 => Area_B_C_E - 18
